research_question: Among workers aged 18-65 living in Mexico City and Estado de Mexico, which dimension of personal time (sleep, exclusive personal hygiene, exclusive household conversation, leisure) shows the strongest negative association with 5 additional hours of weekday commuting (commute_5h: +300 minutes Monday-Friday)? Does the association differ by sex or by the presence of minors in the household?

population.definition: Active workers (P5_1 = 1 or P5_2 in 1-6), not absent in the reference week, with resolved commuting; weights FAC_PER, clusters UPM_DIS, strata EST_DIS

hypotheses.claim: Higher weekday commuting is associated with less time in at least one personal-time dimension
The magnitude of the association differs across sleep, hygiene, household conversation and leisure
The association differs between men and women
The association differs by presence of children or minors in the household

next_action.reason: Start the discovery loop from the real EXP-001 result
